Independently computed resultant verifies this equation with correct sign. Exact symbolic discriminant wrt x is 3125 y^4 D(y)^2, D(y)=y^12+15y^10+71y^8+84y^6+9y^4-3y^2-1, and disc(D)=-2^36*5^18*821^2. The polynomial D is irreducible mod7 by actual factorization (degree12), hence irreducible over Q; the package verifier independently supplies a Rabin gcd certificate over F7. With r(y)=y(17y^10+254y^8+1193y^6+1371y^4+134y^2-1)/40, independently reduced E(r,y), E_x(r,y), E_y(r,y) all to 0 modulo D, giving 12 ordinary double points forming one rational Galois orbit. The parameter-line unibranch singularity at Q of type (2,5) contributes delta=2; P and twelve noncentral nodes contribute 13, saturating rational septic arithmetic genus 15, so no additional geometric singularities. Away from characteristic 2,5,821, the same separability and local-intersection conditions persist: rational ordinary nodes count 1 plus roots(D mod p), including p=7 giving 1 and p=11 giving 3. No unclaimed splitting Galois group or exceptional-characteristic classification is inferred.
